notes: עֵת הָעָרֶב is fused to eventide, headed on the morpheme carrying the lexeme, with the article taking the written the; splitting the two nouns was not available, since the ASV writes one word for both (rules 29, 30).
The three-level chain entrance / gate / city writes three the's: the article on הָעִיר takes the one before its own word and the two constructs take supplied ones (rule 29).
